name: CX516
summary: CX-516 is an ampakine and nootropic that acts as an AMPA receptor positive allosteric modulator and had been undergoing development by a collaboration between Cortex, Shire, and Servier. It was studied as a potential treatment for Alzheimer's disease under the brand name Ampalex, and was also being examined as a treatment for ADHD.

pharmacology.text: CX-516 is an ampakine and nootropic that acts as an AMPA receptor positive allosteric modulator and had been undergoing development by a collaboration between Cortex, Shire, and Servier.

uses.text: It was studied as a potential treatment for Alzheimer's disease under the brand name Ampalex, and was also being examined as a treatment for ADHD. CX-516 was the first ampakine compound developed by Cortex and while it showed good in vitro activity and positive results in animal tests, the human trials proved disappointing due mainly to low potency and short half-life.

fact.en: Ampakines are named after the AMPA receptor, which itself is named after the chemical that scientists use to activate it in the lab, alpha-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid.
fact.zh: Ampakine 類藥物是以 AMPA 受體命名的，而 AMPA 受體的名稱又來自科學家在實驗室中用來活化它的化學物質：α-胺基-3-羥基-5-甲基-4-異噁唑丙酸。
fact.zhHans: Ampakine 类药物是以 AMPA 受体命名的，而 AMPA 受体的名称又来自科学家在实验室中用来活化它的化学物质：α-胺基-3-羟基-5-甲基-4-异恶唑丙酸。
